376	/-! ## O8 `store` (§65) -/
377	
378	/-- Effect of `store(authority, target)` (§65, `ok` effect): `target` becomes the holder, the
379	authority joins `D(target)`, and only leaf `target` becomes `Init`. -/
380	def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
381	  | some y => { s with
382	      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
383	      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
384	      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
385	  | none => s
386	
387	/-- Preconditions of `store` (§65). -/
388	structure StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop where
389	  /-- §65.1: the authority is active, derived, and held by the current frame. -/
390	  derivedHeld : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
391	    y.holder = .frame s.top) False
392	  /-- §65.2: `target` is usable. -/
393	  usable : s.Usable p
394	  /-- §65.2: `target` is a leaf. -/
395	  leaf : isLeaf s.P p
396	  /-- §65.2: exercisable `Modify` over `target`. -/
397	  right : HasRight s .modify p
398	  /-- §65.2: `target` holds no active authority. -/
399	  free : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
400	    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True
401	  /-- §65.3: the authority covers no leaf of `target` nor of storage it owns, transitively. -/
402	  noCover : ∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
403	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q
404	  /-- §65.4: the effective anchor respects `AnchorOrder` relative to the frame of `target`. -/
405	  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p)
406	  /-- §65.5: in the resulting state, `target` is under exercisable `Modify`. -/
407	  keepsTarget : HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p
408	  /-- §65.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
409	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)
410	
411	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `store` (§65). -/
412	instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) :=
413	  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
414	      y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧ s.Usable p ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
415	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
416	      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True) ∧
417	    (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
418	      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
419	    EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧
420	    AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p))
421	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩,
422	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩⟩
423	
424	/-- `store` as a relation (§65). -/
425	def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
426	  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

591	/-- Leaf `l` belongs to a usable place (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1). -/
592	def LeafOfUsable (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
593	  ∃ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q
594	
595	/-- Decidability of `LeafOfUsable` (§66.1). -/
596	instance (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Decidable (LeafOfUsable s l) := by
597	  unfold LeafOfUsable; infer_instance
598	
599	/-- Preconditions of `read` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§66). The type and storage
600	contract of §66.3 is not represented. -/
601	structure Read3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
602	  /-- §66.1: every leaf read belongs to a usable place. -/
603	  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
604	  /-- §66.1: every leaf read is `Init`. -/
605	  init : ∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init
606	  /-- §66.2: `access` is exercisable in `Observe`. -/
607	  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
608	  /-- §66.2: the effective mode of `access` permits observation of each leaf. -/
609	  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
610	  /-- §66.3: required anchors are valid. -/
611	  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l
612	
613	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `read` (§66). -/
614	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Read3Pre s a ls) :=
615	  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init) ∧
616	    s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none) ∧
617	    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
618	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
619	
620	/-- `read` as a relation (§66): the state is unchanged. -/
621	def Read3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
622	  Guarded (Read3Pre s a ls) s

624	/-- Preconditions of an ordinary `write` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§67). The type,
625	storage and abstraction constraints of §67.3 are not represented. -/
626	structure Write3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where

628	  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
629	  /-- §67.1: `access` is exercisable in `Modify`. -/
630	  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .modify
631	  /-- §67.1: `access` has effective `Modify` over each leaf. -/
632	  effectiveModify : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify
633	  /-- §67.2: no other authority holds an effective mode, all incompatible with `Modify` (§50),
634	  over the written leaves. -/
635	  exclusive : ∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none
636	  /-- §67.3: anchors remain valid. -/
637	  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l
638	
639	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `write` (§67). -/
640	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Write3Pre s a ls) :=
641	  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ s.ExercisableAt a .modify ∧
642	    (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify) ∧
643	    (∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none) ∧
644	    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
645	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
646	
647	/-- Effect of a write (§67, §68, `ok` effect): the written leaves become `Init`. -/
648	def write3Eff (s : S3) (ls : List Nat) : S3 :=
649	  { s with I := fun p => if p ∈ ls then .init else s.I p }
650	
651	/-- `write` as a relation (§67). -/
652	def Write3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
653	  Guarded (Write3Pre s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)
654	
655	/-- Preconditions of `writeShared` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§68). -/
656	structure WriteSharedPre (k : K) (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
657	  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is usable (belongs to a usable place). -/
658	  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
659	  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is declared `K.SharedMutable`. -/
660	  shared : ∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l
661	  /-- §68.2: `access` is exercisable in a mode at least `Observe`. -/
662	  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
663	  /-- §68.2: `access` has a present effective mode on every leaf. -/
664	  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
665	  /-- §68.3: dependencies are valid. -/
666	  depsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l
667	
668	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `writeShared` (§68). -/
669	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) :
670	    Decidable (WriteSharedPre k s a ls) :=
671	  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l) ∧
672	    s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
673	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
674	
675	/-- `writeShared` as a relation (§68). -/
676	def WriteSharedStep (k : K) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
677	  Guarded (WriteSharedPre k s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)
678	
679	/-! ## Release of authorities whose holder dies (§69, §70) -/
680	
681	/-- Releases every authority whose holder is no longer live (§69, §70 `ok` effects). -/
682	def cleanup (s : S3) : S3 :=

950	  | reject : ¬ AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → AllocStep k provider owner ls s .reject
951	
952	/-! ## O15 `pin`, O16 `unpin` (§74, §75) -/
953	
954	/-- Preconditions of `pin` (§74). "Applicable pinning obligations" is not represented. -/
955	structure PinPre (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
956	  /-- §74: `place` is usable. -/
957	  usable : s.Usable p
958	  /-- §74: exercisable `Modify` over the leaves of `place`. -/
959	  right : HasRight s .modify p
960	
961	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `pin` (§74). -/
962	instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (PinPre s p) :=
963	  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p)
964	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩
965	
966	/-- Effect of `pin` (§74, `ok` effect): an active dynamic pinning obligation of fresh identity
967	`|pins|` is installed on the leaves of `place`. -/
968	def pinEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
969	  { s with pins := s.pins ++ [⟨p, footprint s.P p, true⟩] }
970	
971	/-- `pin` as a relation (§74). -/
972	def PinStep (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (PinPre s p) (pinEff s p)
973	
974	/-- Effect of `unpin` (§75, `ok` effect): the designated obligation `o` ends, and only that
975	one. -/
976	def unpinEff (s : S3) (o : Nat) : S3 :=
977	  { s with pins := s.pins.modify o fun ob => { ob with active := false } }
978	
979	/-- Preconditions of `unpin o` (§75), `o` the identity of a dynamic pinning obligation. -/
980	structure UnpinPre (k : K) (s : S3) (o : Nat) : Prop where
981	  /-- §75: `unpin` designates an active dynamic pinning obligation. -/
982	  active : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False
983	  /-- §75: `place`, on which the obligation was installed by `pin`, is usable. -/
984	  usable : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False
985	  /-- §75: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
986	  right : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False
987	  /-- §75: `K.ExternalDone`, applied to the obligation. -/
988	  externalDone : k.ExternalDone o
989	
990	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `unpin` (§75). -/
991	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] (s : S3) (o : Nat) :
992	    Decidable (UnpinPre k s o) :=
993	  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False ∧
994	    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False ∧
995	    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False ∧ k.ExternalDone o)
996	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩
997	
998	/-- `unpin` as a relation (§75). -/
999	def UnpinStep (k : K) (o : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
1000	  Guarded (UnpinPre k s o) (unpinEff s o)
1001	
1002	/-! ## Kernel steps (§57, §58) -/
1003	
1004	/-- One `ok` transition of a kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75; §57 reachability). -/
1005	inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
1006	  | derive {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} :
1007	      DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1008	  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
1009	      SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1010	  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1011	  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1012	  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : DependStep q x s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1013	  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
1014	      EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1015	  | exit {s s' : S3} : ExitStep k s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1016	  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1017	  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1018	  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
1019	      WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1020	  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : PinStep p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1021	  | unpin {s s' : S3} {o : Nat} : UnpinStep k o s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1022	  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1023	  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1024	  | alloc {s s' : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
1025	      AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1026	  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} : StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1027

3	/-!
4	# Renaming of identities: core definitions
5	
6	Foundation of the renaming bisimulation of the access kernel for
7	`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §49, last paragraph: renamings of place and
8	authority identities (`Ren`), the relation they induce on places, authorities, pinning
9	obligations (§74, §75) and states (§38), the order facts carried along runs (`Down`, `SibMono`),
10	the renamed contract (§48, §80), the renamed operations (§60–§75), and the relation of outcomes
11	(§58). Generic lemmas on these relations, closed by symmetry.
12	-/
13	
14	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
15	
16	namespace Rename
17	
18	/-! ## Renamings (§49, last paragraph) -/
19	
20	/-- A renaming of identities (§49, last paragraph): a bijection of `Nat` with its inverse. -/
21	structure Ren where
22	  f : Nat → Nat
23	  g : Nat → Nat
24	  gf : ∀ i, g (f i) = i
25	  fg : ∀ i, f (g i) = i
26	
27	/-- The identity renaming (§49, last paragraph). -/
28	def Ren.id : Ren := ⟨fun i => i, fun i => i, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
29	
30	/-- The inverse renaming (§49, last paragraph). -/
31	def Ren.symm (π : Ren) : Ren := ⟨π.g, π.f, π.fg, π.gf⟩
32	
33	/-- Composition of renamings, `π` first (§49, last paragraph). -/
34	def Ren.comp (π' π : Ren) : Ren :=
35	  ⟨fun i => π'.f (π.f i), fun i => π.g (π'.g i), fun i => by simp [π'.gf, π.gf],
36	   fun i => by simp [π'.fg, π.fg]⟩
37	
38	/-- Renaming of a permutation `τ` of `List.range n` (§49, last paragraph): old `x < n` goes to its
39	position in `τ`, new `i < n` comes from `τ[i]`; identity from `n` on. -/
40	def Ren.ofPerm (τ : List Nat) (n : Nat) (h : τ.Perm (List.range n)) : Ren where
41	  f x := if x < n then τ.idxOf x else x
42	  g i := if hi : i < τ.length then τ[i] else i
43	  gf x := by
44	    have hl : τ.length = n := by simpa using h.length_eq
45	    by_cases hx : x < n
46	    · have hm : x ∈ τ := h.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hx)
47	      have hi := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem hm
48	      simp [hx, hi, List.getElem_idxOf hi]
49	    · simp [hx, hl]
50	  fg i := by
51	    have hl : τ.length = n := by simpa using h.length_eq
52	    have hnd : τ.Nodup := h.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range
53	    by_cases hi : i < τ.length
54	    · have hlt : τ[i] < n := List.mem_range.1 (h.mem_iff.1 (List.getElem_mem hi))
55	      simp only [hi, dite_true, hlt, ite_true]
56	      exact (List.Nodup.getElem_inj hnd).1
57	        (List.getElem_idxOf (List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (List.getElem_mem hi)))
58	    · simp [hi, hl ▸ hi]
59	
60	/-- The inverse of `π` maps forward by `π.g` (§49, last paragraph). -/
61	@[simp] theorem Ren.symm_f (π : Ren) (i : Nat) : π.symm.f i = π.g i := rfl
62	
63	/-- The inverse of `π` maps backward by `π.f` (§49, last paragraph). -/
64	@[simp] theorem Ren.symm_g (π : Ren) (i : Nat) : π.symm.g i = π.f i := rfl
65	
66	/-- The inverse of the inverse is the renaming (§49, last paragraph). -/
67	theorem Ren.symm_symm (π : Ren) : π.symm.symm = π := rfl
68	
69	/-- A renaming is injective (§49, last paragraph). -/
70	theorem Ren.f_inj (π : Ren) {i j : Nat} : π.f i = π.f j ↔ i = j :=
71	  ⟨fun h => by rw [← π.gf i, h, π.gf], fun h => h ▸ rfl⟩
72	
73	/-- A renaming is determined by its forward map (§49, last paragraph). -/
74	theorem Ren.ext {π π' : Ren} (h : ∀ i, π.f i = π'.f i) : π = π' := by
75	  have hg : ∀ i, π.g i = π'.g i := fun i =>
76	    calc π.g i = π.g (π.f (π'.g i)) := by rw [h, π'.fg]
77	      _ = π'.g i := π.gf _
78	  obtain ⟨f, g, _, _⟩ := π
79	  obtain ⟨f', g', _, _⟩ := π'
80	  simp only [Ren.mk.injEq]
81	  exact ⟨funext h, funext hg⟩
82	
83	/-- A renaming composed with its inverse is the identity (§49, last paragraph). -/
84	theorem Ren.symm_comp (π : Ren) : π.symm.comp π = Ren.id := Ren.ext fun i => π.gf i
85	
86	/-- Mapping by `π.f` then `π.g` is the identity on lists (§49, last paragraph). -/
87	theorem Ren.map_gf (π : Ren) (l : List Nat) : (l.map π.f).map π.g = l := by
88	  simp [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, π.gf]
89	
90	/-- Mapping by `π.g` then `π.f` is the identity on lists (§49, last paragraph). -/
91	theorem Ren.map_fg (π : Ren) (l : List Nat) : (l.map π.g).map π.f = l := by
92	  simp [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, π.fg]
93	
94	/-- Membership in a renamed list, read backward (§49, last paragraph). -/
95	theorem Ren.mem_map (π : Ren) (l : List Nat) (y : Nat) : y ∈ l.map π.f ↔ π.g y ∈ l := by
96	  constructor
97	  · intro hy; obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy; rwa [π.gf]
98	  · intro hy; exact List.mem_map.2 ⟨π.g y, hy, π.fg y⟩
99	
100	/-- Membership of a renamed identity in a renamed list (§49, last paragraph). -/
101	theorem Ren.mem_map_f (π : Ren) (l : List Nat) (x : Nat) : π.f x ∈ l.map π.f ↔ x ∈ l := by
102	  rw [π.mem_map, π.gf]
103	
104	/-- The f-form of a membership correspondence gives its g-form (§49, last paragraph). -/
105	theorem Ren.mem_iff_g (π : Ren) {L L' : List Nat} (h : ∀ x, π.f x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ L) (y : Nat) :
106	    y ∈ L' ↔ π.g y ∈ L := by rw [← h, π.fg]
107	
108	/-- Universal quantification over all identities, renamed (§49, last paragraph). -/
109	theorem Ren.forall_iff (π : Ren) {Q Q' : Nat → Prop} (hQ : ∀ x, Q' (π.f x) ↔ Q x) :
110	    (∀ y, Q' y) ↔ ∀ x, Q x :=
111	  ⟨fun h x => (hQ x).1 (h _), fun h y => by rw [← π.fg y]; exact (hQ _).2 (h _)⟩
112	
113	/-- Universal quantification over corresponding lists (§49, last paragraph). -/
114	theorem Ren.forall_mem_iff (π : Ren) {L L' : List Nat} (hL : ∀ x, π.f x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ L)
115	    {Q Q' : Nat → Prop} (hQ : ∀ x, Q' (π.f x) ↔ Q x) :
116	    (∀ y ∈ L', Q' y) ↔ ∀ x ∈ L, Q x :=
117	  ⟨fun h x hx => (hQ x).1 (h _ ((hL x).2 hx)),
118	   fun h y hy => by
119	    rw [← π.fg y] at hy ⊢; exact (hQ _).2 (h _ ((hL _).1 hy))⟩
120	
121	/-- Existential quantification over corresponding lists (§49, last paragraph). -/
122	theorem Ren.exists_mem_iff (π : Ren) {L L' : List Nat} (hL : ∀ x, π.f x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ L)
123	    {Q Q' : Nat → Prop} (hQ : ∀ x, Q' (π.f x) ↔ Q x) :
124	    (∃ y ∈ L', Q' y) ↔ ∃ x ∈ L, Q x :=
125	  ⟨fun ⟨y, hy, hq⟩ => by
126	    rw [← π.fg y] at hy hq; exact ⟨_, (hL _).1 hy, (hQ _).1 hq⟩,
127	   fun ⟨x, hx, hq⟩ => ⟨_, (hL x).2 hx, (hQ x).2 hq⟩⟩
128	
129	/-- Duplicate-free lists with corresponding members are permutations up to renaming (§42: sets
130	represented by lists; §49, last paragraph). -/
131	theorem Ren.perm_of_mem (π : Ren) {L L' : List Nat} (hnd : L.Nodup) (hnd' : L'.Nodup)
132	    (h : ∀ x, π.f x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ L) : L'.Perm (L.map π.f) := by
133	  have hm : (L.map π.f).Nodup :=
134	    List.pairwise_map.2 (hnd.imp fun hab e => hab ((Ren.f_inj π).1 e))
135	  refine (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup hnd' hm).2 fun y => ?_
136	  rw [π.mem_iff_g h, π.mem_map]
137	
138	/-! ## Generic list and option lemmas -/
139	
140	/-- A duplicate-free list of `n` identities below `n` is a permutation of `List.range n` (§49,
141	last paragraph). -/
142	theorem perm_range_of_nodup {l : List Nat} {n : Nat} (hnd : l.Nodup) (hlt : ∀ a ∈ l, a < n)
143	    (hlen : l.length = n) : l.Perm (List.range n) := by
144	  refine (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup hnd List.nodup_range).2 fun a =>
145	    ⟨fun ha => List.mem_range.2 (hlt a ha), fun ha => ?_⟩
146	  refine Classical.byContradiction fun hna => ?_
147	  have hsub : l ⊆ (List.range n).erase a := fun b hb =>
148	    (List.mem_erase_of_ne (fun e => hna (by subst e; exact hb))).2 (List.mem_range.2 (hlt b hb))
149	  have := List.Nodup.length_le_of_subset hnd hsub
150	  rw [List.length_erase_of_mem ha, List.length_range] at this
151	  have : 0 < n := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) (List.mem_range.1 ha)
152	  omega

154	/-- `flatMap` of pointwise permutations is a permutation (§44: `D(p)` is a set; §49, last
155	paragraph). -/
156	theorem perm_flatMap_pointwise {α β : Type} {f g : α → List β} :
157	    ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ a ∈ l, (f a).Perm (g a)) → (l.flatMap f).Perm (l.flatMap g)
158	  | [], _ => .nil
159	  | a :: l, h => by
160	    simp only [List.flatMap_cons]
161	    exact (h a (List.mem_cons_self ..)).append
162	      (perm_flatMap_pointwise fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb))
163	
164	/-- Positions are kept by an injective map (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
165	theorem posIn_map {f : Nat → Nat} (hf : ∀ i j, f i = f j → i = j) (r : Nat) :
166	    ∀ l : List Nat, posIn (f r) (l.map f) = posIn r l
167	  | [] => rfl
168	  | a :: l => by
169	    simp only [List.map_cons, posIn, posIn_map hf r l]
170	    by_cases h : a = r
171	    · subst h; simp
172	    · have : f a ≠ f r := fun e => h (hf _ _ e)
173	      simp [h, this]
174	
175	/-- Two strictly sorted lists with the same members are equal (§63.2: children in index order;
176	§49, last paragraph). -/
177	theorem eq_of_sorted_mem {l l' : List Nat} (h : l.Pairwise (· < ·)) (h' : l'.Pairwise (· < ·))
178	    (hm : ∀ a, a ∈ l ↔ a ∈ l') : l = l' :=
179	  List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise (le := (· < ·))
180	    (fun _ _ _ _ hab hba => absurd (Nat.lt_trans hab hba) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)) h h'
181	    ((List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup (h.imp Nat.ne_of_lt) (h'.imp Nat.ne_of_lt)).2 hm)
182	
183	/-- A related `some` has a related `some` (§38: components read by index; §49, last
184	paragraph). -/
185	theorem optionRel_some {α β : Type} {r : α → β → Prop} {o : Option α} {o' : Option β} {a : α}
186	    (h : Option.Rel r o o') (ha : o = some a) : ∃ b, o' = some b ∧ r a b := by
187	  subst ha; cases h with | some h => exact ⟨_, rfl, h⟩
188	
189	/-- A related `some`, read backward (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
190	theorem optionRel_some' {α β : Type} {r : α → β → Prop} {o : Option α} {o' : Option β} {b : β}
191	    (h : Option.Rel r o o') (hb : o' = some b) : ∃ a, o = some a ∧ r a b := by
192	  subst hb; cases h with | some h => exact ⟨_, rfl, h⟩
193	
194	/-- Related options are `none` together (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
195	theorem optionRel_none_iff {α β : Type} {r : α → β → Prop} {o : Option α} {o' : Option β}
196	    (h : Option.Rel r o o') : o = none ↔ o' = none := by
197	  cases h <;> simp
198	
199	/-- Symmetry of `Option.Rel` (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
200	theorem optionRel_symm {α β : Type} {r : α → β → Prop} {r' : β → α → Prop}
201	    (hr : ∀ a b, r a b → r' b a) : ∀ {o o'}, Option.Rel r o o' → Option.Rel r' o' o
202	  | _, _, .some h => .some (hr _ _ h)
203	  | _, _, .none => .none
204	
205	/-- Transitivity of `Option.Rel` (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
206	theorem optionRel_trans {α β γ : Type} {r : α → β → Prop} {r' : β → γ → Prop}
207	    {r'' : α → γ → Prop} (hr : ∀ a b c, r a b → r' b c → r'' a c) :
208	    ∀ {o o' o''}, Option.Rel r o o' → Option.Rel r' o' o'' → Option.Rel r'' o o''
209	  | _, _, _, .some h, .some h' => .some (hr _ _ _ h h')
210	  | _, _, _, .none, .none => .none
211

223	/-- A place renamed (§40; §49, last paragraph): parent and owner renamed, `kind` kept. -/

234	  ⟨fun h => by rw [← Holder.ren_symm π a, h, Holder.ren_symm], fun h => h ▸ rfl⟩

241	theorem Holder.isPlace_ren (π : Ren) (h : Holder) : (h.ren π).isPlace = h.isPlace := by

244	/-- Renaming a place back (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
245	theorem Place.ren_symm (π : Ren) (pl : Place) : (pl.ren π).ren π.symm = pl := by
246	  obtain ⟨p, o, k⟩ := pl
247	  simp only [Place.ren, Holder.ren_symm, Option.map_map]
248	  cases p <;> simp [π.gf]

250	/-- Renaming places twice is renaming by the composition (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
251	theorem Place.ren_comp (π π' : Ren) (pl : Place) : (pl.ren π).ren π' = pl.ren (π'.comp π) := by
252	  obtain ⟨p, o, k⟩ := pl
253	  simp only [Place.ren, Holder.ren_comp, Option.map_map]

256	/-! ## Related authorities, obligations, places and states (§38, §40, §42, §74, §75) -/
257	
258	/-- Authorities related by the renaming (§42; §49, last paragraph); footprints up to permutation
259	(§42: a set). -/
260	structure AuthRel (π α : Ren) (y y' : Authority) : Prop where
261	  mode : y'.mode = y.mode
262	  origin : y'.origin = y.origin.map α.f
263	  footprint : y'.footprint.Perm (y.footprint.map π.f)
264	  holder : y'.holder = y.holder.ren π
265	  active : y'.active = y.active
266	
267	/-- Pinning obligations related by the renaming (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph); identities
268	kept, leaves up to permutation. -/
269	structure PinRel (π : Ren) (ob ob' : PinOb) : Prop where
270	  place : ob'.place = π.f ob.place
271	  leaves : ob'.leaves.Perm (ob.leaves.map π.f)
272	  active : ob'.active = ob.active
273	
274	/-- Place lists related by the renaming (§40; §49, last paragraph); fresh identities fixed. -/
275	structure PRel (π : Ren) (P P' : List Place) : Prop where
276	  len : P'.length = P.length
277	  get : ∀ q, P'[π.f q]? = (P[q]?).map (Place.ren π)
278	  fix : ∀ q, P.length ≤ q → π.f q = q
279	
280	/-- States related by place renaming `π` and authority renaming `α` (§38; §49, last paragraph);
281	footprints, anchors (§44: a set) and pinned leaves up to permutation. -/
282	structure SRel (π α : Ren) (s s' : S3) : Prop where
283	  F : s'.F = s.F
284	  nF : s'.nF = s.nF
285	  P : PRel π s.P s'.P
286	  I : ∀ l, s'.I (π.f l) = s.I l
287	  Alen : s'.A.length = s.A.length
288	  A : ∀ x, Option.Rel (AuthRel π α) (s.A[x]?) (s'.A[α.f x]?)
289	  Afix : ∀ x, s.A.length ≤ x → α.f x = x
290	  D : ∀ q, (s'.D (π.f q)).Perm ((s.D q).map α.f)
291	  dead : ∀ q, s'.dead (π.f q) = s.dead q
292	  pins : ∀ o : Nat, Option.Rel (PinRel π) (s.pins[o]?) (s'.pins[o]?)
293	
294	/-- Parent links go to smaller identities (§49.2; representation of acyclicity, §49 last
295	paragraph). -/
296	def DownP (P : List Place) : Prop := ∀ j o, parentOf P j = some o → o < j
297	
298	/-- Origin links go to smaller identities (§49.5; representation of acyclicity, §49 last
299	paragraph). -/
300	def DownA (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ j o, s.org j = some o → o < j
301	
302	/-- Parent and origin links go to smaller identities (§49.2, §49.5; §49, last paragraph). -/
303	def Down (s : S3) : Prop := DownP s.P ∧ DownA s
304	
305	/-- `π` keeps the order of the parts of every place, their positional field order (§63.2; §49,
306	last paragraph). -/
307	def SibMono (π : Ren) (P : List Place) : Prop :=
308	  ∀ x y p, parentOf P x = some p → parentOf P y = some p → x < y → π.f x < π.f y
309	
310	/-- The simulation invariant (§49, last paragraph; §57): related states, both with downward
311	links, and `π` keeping field order (§63.2). -/
312	structure Sim (π α : Ren) (s s' : S3) : Prop where
313	  rel : SRel π α s s'
314	  down : Down s
315	  down' : Down s'
316	  sib : SibMono π s.P
317	
318	/-- Owner-accepted hypothesis of 2026-11-06 on `Satisfiable` (§71, §48; §49, last paragraph): it
319	does not distinguish states equal up to permutation of footprint, anchor and pin-leaf lists
320	(§42, §44). -/
321	def KExt (k : K) : Prop :=
322	  ∀ p sh s t, SRel Ren.id Ren.id s t → k.Satisfiable p sh s → k.Satisfiable p sh t
323	
324	end Rename

326	/-! ## Renamed contract and operations (§48, §60–§75, §80) -/
327	
328	/-- The contract renamed (§48, §80; §49, last paragraph). `FreeCompat`'s `auth` is opaque
329	(§70.2); obligations keep their identities (§75); `Satisfiable` (§71) is read on related
330	states. -/
331	def K.rename (π α : Ren) (k : K) : K where
332	  DeclaredDisjoint r r' := k.DeclaredDisjoint (r.map π.g) (r'.map π.g)
333	  SharedMutable l := k.SharedMutable (π.g l)
334	  Pinned l := k.Pinned (π.g l)
335	  ExternalDone o := k.ExternalDone o
336	  Deallocable p := k.Deallocable (π.g p)
337	  FreeCompat p a := k.FreeCompat (π.g p) a
338	  Satisfiable p sh t := ∃ t₀, SRel π α t₀ t ∧ k.Satisfiable (π.g p) sh t₀
339	
340	/-- Arguments renamed (§60–§75; §49, last paragraph). Shapes are not renamed (§71.1, §72.2:
341	fresh parents); `auth` is opaque (§70.2); `o` is an obligation identity (§75). -/
342	def KernelOp.ren (π α : Ren) : KernelOp → KernelOp
343	  | .derive src region m => .derive (α.f src) (region.map π.f) m
344	  | .split src rs => .split (α.f src) (rs.map (·.map π.f))
345	  | .release a => .release (α.f a)
346	  | .transfer src dst => .transfer (π.f src) (π.f dst)
347	  | .depend q x => .depend (π.f q) (α.f x)
348	  | .enter ps ls => .enter (ps.map α.f) ls
349	  | .exit => .exit
350	  | .read a ls => .read (α.f a) (ls.map π.f)
351	  | .write a ls => .write (α.f a) (ls.map π.f)
352	  | .writeShared a ls => .writeShared (α.f a) (ls.map π.f)
353	  | .pin p => .pin (π.f p)
354	  | .unpin o => .unpin o
355	  | .endUse p => .endUse (π.f p)
356	  | .free p auth => .free (π.f p) auth
357	  | .alloc pr ow ls => .alloc (π.f pr) (π.f ow) ls
358	  | .store a p => .store (α.f a) (π.f p)

388	/-- Related place lists have related bounds (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
389	theorem PRel.lt_iff (hP : PRel π P P') (q : Nat) : π.f q < P'.length ↔ q < P.length := by
390	  have := hP.get q
391	  constructor
392	  · intro hq
393	    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hq] at this
394	    cases e : P[q]? with
395	    | none => rw [e] at this; cases this
396	    | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 e).1
397	  · intro hq
398	    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hq] at this
399	    cases e : P'[π.f q]? with
400	    | none => rw [e] at this; cases this
401	    | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 e).1
402	
403	/-- Membership in the place range, renamed (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
404	theorem PRel.mem_range (hP : PRel π P P') (q : Nat) :
405	    π.f q ∈ List.range P'.length ↔ q ∈ List.range P.length := by
406	  simp only [List.mem_range, hP.lt_iff]
407	
408	/-- Universal quantification over the places, renamed (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
409	theorem PRel.forall_range (hP : PRel π P P') {Q : Nat → Prop} :
410	    (∀ y ∈ List.range P'.length, Q y) ↔ ∀ x ∈ List.range P.length, Q (π.f x) :=
411	  π.forall_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun _ => Iff.rfl
412	
413	/-- Existential quantification over the places, renamed (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
414	theorem PRel.exists_range (hP : PRel π P P') {Q : Nat → Prop} :
415	    (∃ y ∈ List.range P'.length, Q y) ↔ ∃ x ∈ List.range P.length, Q (π.f x) :=
416	  π.exists_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun _ => Iff.rfl
417	
418	/-- Symmetry of related place lists (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
419	theorem PRel.symm (hP : PRel π P P') : PRel π.symm P' P where
420	  len := hP.len.symm
421	  get q := by
422	    have := hP.get (π.g q)
423	    rw [π.fg] at this
424	    rw [Ren.symm_f, this, Option.map_map]
425	    cases P[π.g q]? <;> simp [Function.comp_def, Place.ren_symm]
426	  fix q hq := by
427	    have := hP.fix q (hP.len ▸ hq)
428	    show π.g q = q
429	    conv => lhs; rw [← this]
430	    exact π.gf q
431	
432	/-- Transitivity of related place lists (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
433	theorem PRel.trans (hP : PRel π P P') (hP' : PRel π' P' P'') : PRel (π'.comp π) P P'' where
434	  len := hP'.len.trans hP.len
435	  get q := by
436	    show P''[π'.f (π.f q)]? = _
437	    rw [hP'.get, hP.get, Option.map_map]
438	    congr 1; funext pl; exact Place.ren_comp π π' pl
439	  fix q hq := by
440	    show π'.f (π.f q) = q
441	    rw [hP.fix q hq, hP'.fix q (hP.len ▸ hq)]
442	
443	/-- Authorities related: footprint membership (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
444	theorem AuthRel.mem_footprint {y y' : Authority} (hr : AuthRel π α y y') (l : Nat) :
445	    π.f l ∈ y'.footprint ↔ l ∈ y.footprint :=
446	  hr.footprint.mem_iff.trans (π.mem_map_f _ _)
447	
448	/-- Symmetry of related authorities (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
449	theorem AuthRel.symm {y y' : Authority} (h : AuthRel π α y y') : AuthRel π.symm α.symm y' y where
450	  mode := h.mode.symm
451	  origin := by rw [h.origin, Option.map_map]; cases y.origin <;> simp [α.gf]
452	  footprint := by
453	    have := h.footprint.map π.g
454	    rw [Ren.map_gf] at this; exact this.symm
455	  holder := by rw [h.holder, Holder.ren_symm]
456	  active := h.active.symm
457	
458	/-- Transitivity of related authorities (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
459	theorem AuthRel.trans {y y' y'' : Authority} (h : AuthRel π α y y') (h' : AuthRel π' α' y' y'') :
460	    AuthRel (π'.comp π) (α'.comp α) y y'' where
461	  mode := h'.mode.trans h.mode
462	  origin := by rw [h'.origin, h.origin, Option.map_map]; rfl
463	  footprint := h'.footprint.trans ((h.footprint.map π'.f).trans (by rw [List.map_map]; rfl))
464	  holder := by rw [h'.holder, h.holder, Holder.ren_comp]
465	  active := h'.active.trans h.active
466	
467	/-- Related obligations: leaf membership (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph). -/
468	theorem PinRel.mem_leaves {ob ob' : PinOb} (hr : PinRel π ob ob') (l : Nat) :
469	    π.f l ∈ ob'.leaves ↔ l ∈ ob.leaves :=
470	  hr.leaves.mem_iff.trans (π.mem_map_f _ _)
471	
472	/-- Symmetry of related obligations (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph). -/
473	theorem PinRel.symm {ob ob' : PinOb} (h : PinRel π ob ob') : PinRel π.symm ob' ob where
474	  place := by rw [h.place]; exact (π.gf _).symm
475	  leaves := by have := h.leaves.map π.g; rw [Ren.map_gf] at this; exact this.symm
476	  active := h.active.symm
477	
478	/-- Transitivity of related obligations (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph). -/
479	theorem PinRel.trans {ob ob' ob'' : PinOb} (h : PinRel π ob ob') (h' : PinRel π' ob' ob'') :
480	    PinRel (π'.comp π) ob ob'' where
481	  place := by rw [h'.place, h.place]; rfl
482	  leaves := h'.leaves.trans ((h.leaves.map π'.f).trans (by rw [List.map_map]; rfl))
483	  active := h'.active.trans h.active
484	
485	/-- Symmetry of related states (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
486	theorem SRel.symm (h : SRel π α s s') : SRel π.symm α.symm s' s where
487	  F := h.F.symm
488	  nF := h.nF.symm
489	  P := h.P.symm
490	  I l := by have := h.I (π.g l); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
491	  Alen := h.Alen.symm
492	  A x := by
493	    have := optionRel_symm (fun _ _ hy => AuthRel.symm hy) (h.A (α.g x))
494	    rw [α.fg] at this; exact this
495	  Afix x hx := by
496	    have := h.Afix x (h.Alen ▸ hx)
497	    show α.g x = x
498	    conv => lhs; rw [← this]
499	    exact α.gf x
500	  D q := by
501	    have := (h.D (π.g q)).map α.g
502	    rw [π.fg, Ren.map_gf] at this; exact this.symm
503	  dead q := by have := h.dead (π.g q); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
504	  pins o := optionRel_symm (fun _ _ hy => PinRel.symm hy) (h.pins o)
505	
506	/-- Transitivity of related states (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
507	theorem SRel.trans (h : SRel π α s s') (h' : SRel π' α' s' s'') :
508	    SRel (π'.comp π) (α'.comp α) s s'' where
509	  F := h'.F.trans h.F
510	  nF := h'.nF.trans h.nF
511	  P := h.P.trans h'.P
512	  I l := (h'.I (π.f l)).trans (h.I l)
513	  Alen := h'.Alen.trans h.Alen
514	  A x := optionRel_trans (r := AuthRel π α) (r' := AuthRel π' α')
515	    (r'' := AuthRel (π'.comp π) (α'.comp α))
516	    (fun _ _ _ hy hy' => AuthRel.trans hy hy') (h.A x) (h'.A (α.f x))
517	  Afix x hx := by
518	    show α'.f (α.f x) = x
519	    rw [h.Afix x hx, h'.Afix x (h.Alen ▸ hx)]
520	  D q := (h'.D (π.f q)).trans (((h.D q).map α'.f).trans (by rw [List.map_map]; rfl))
521	  dead q := (h'.dead (π.f q)).trans (h.dead q)
522	  pins o := optionRel_trans (r := PinRel π) (r' := PinRel π') (r'' := PinRel (π'.comp π))
523	    (fun _ _ _ hy hy' => PinRel.trans hy hy') (h.pins o) (h'.pins o)
524	
525	/-- Related states with the same new frame stack are related (§38, §39; §49, last
526	paragraph). -/
527	theorem SRel.withF (h : SRel π α s s') (F₀ : Frames) :
528	    SRel π α { s with F := F₀ } { s' with F := F₀ } :=
529	  { h with F := rfl }
530	
531	/-- An existing authority has a related authority (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/

561	theorem SRel.Alt (h : SRel π α s s') (x : Nat) : α.f x < s'.A.length ↔ x < s.A.length := by
562	  have := h.A_none x
563	  rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff] at this

567	theorem SRel.mem_rangeA (h : SRel π α s s') (x : Nat) :
568	    α.f x ∈ List.range s'.A.length ↔ x ∈ List.range s.A.length := by
569	  simp only [List.mem_range, h.Alt]

572	theorem SRel.forall_rangeA (h : SRel π α s s') {Q : Nat → Prop} :
573	    (∀ y ∈ List.range s'.A.length, Q y) ↔ ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, Q (α.f x) :=
574	  α.forall_mem_iff h.mem_rangeA fun _ => Iff.rfl

577	theorem SRel.exists_rangeA (h : SRel π α s s') {Q : Nat → Prop} :
578	    (∃ y ∈ List.range s'.A.length, Q y) ↔ ∃ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, Q (α.f x) :=

581	/-- `WF3` gives downward links (§49.2, §49.5; §49, last paragraph). -/
582	theorem Down.of_wf3 (hw : WF3 s) : Down s := by
583	  refine ⟨fun _ _ hp => (hw.parent_lt hp).1, fun j o ho => ?_⟩
584	  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyo⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.1 ho
585	  exact hw.origins j y o hy hyo
586	
587	/-- Field order kept by `π` is kept by its inverse on the related list (§63.2; §49, last
588	paragraph). -/
589	theorem SibMono.symm (hP : PRel π P P') (hs : SibMono π P) : SibMono π.symm P' := by
590	  have hpar : ∀ x p, parentOf P' x = some p → parentOf P (π.g x) = some (π.g p) := by
591	    intro x p hx
592	    have := hP.get (π.g x)
593	    rw [π.fg] at this
594	    simp only [parentOf, this] at hx ⊢
595	    cases e : P[π.g x]? with
596	    | none => rw [e] at hx; cases hx
597	    | some pl =>
598	      rw [e] at hx
599	      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some, Place.ren] at hx
600	      cases hpp : pl.parent with
601	      | none => rw [hpp] at hx; cases hx
602	      | some r =>
603	        rw [hpp] at hx; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hx
604	        simp only [Option.bind_some, hpp, ← hx, π.gf]
605	  intro x y p hx hy hxy
606	  simp only [Ren.symm_f]
607	  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy (π.g x) (π.g y) with hlt | heq | hgt
608	  · exact hlt
609	  · exact absurd ((by rw [← π.fg x, heq, π.fg] : x = y) ▸ hxy) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
610	  · have := hs _ _ _ (hpar y p hy) (hpar x p hx) hgt
611	    rw [π.fg, π.fg] at this; omega
612	
613	/-- Field order depends only on the parent links (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
614	theorem SibMono.congr {P₁ : List Place} (hpar : parentOf P₁ = parentOf P) (hs : SibMono π P) :
615	    SibMono π P₁ := by
616	  intro x y p hx hy; rw [hpar] at hx hy; exact hs x y p hx hy
617	
618	/-- Symmetry of the simulation invariant (§49, last paragraph; §57). -/
619	theorem Sim.symm (hS : Sim π α s s') : Sim π.symm α.symm s' s where
620	  rel := hS.rel.symm
621	  down := hS.down'
622	  down' := hS.down
623	  sib := SibMono.symm hS.rel.P hS.sib
624	
625	/-- The renamed contract corresponds to the contract (§48, §80; §49, last paragraph). -/
626	theorem KCorr.rename (π α : Ren) (k : K) : KCorr π α k (k.rename π α) where
627	  dd r r' := by simp only [K.rename, Ren.map_gf]
628	  shared l := by simp only [K.rename, π.gf]
629	  pinned l := by simp only [K.rename, π.gf]
630	  done _ := Iff.rfl
631	  dealloc p := by simp only [K.rename, π.gf]
632	  compat p a := by simp only [K.rename, π.gf]
633	
634	/-- Symmetry of corresponding contracts (§48, §80; §49, last paragraph). -/
635	theorem KCorr.symm {k k' : K} (hK : KCorr π α k k') : KCorr π.symm α.symm k' k where
636	  dd r r' := by
637	    have := hK.dd (r.map π.g) (r'.map π.g)
638	    rw [Ren.map_fg, Ren.map_fg] at this; exact this.symm
639	  shared l := by have := hK.shared (π.g l); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
640	  pinned l := by have := hK.pinned (π.g l); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
641	  done o := (hK.done o).symm
642	  dealloc p := by have := hK.dealloc (π.g p); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
643	  compat p a := by have := hK.compat (π.g p) a; rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
644	
645	/-- `DDSound` (§80, §23) is invariant under renaming of the contract (§49, last paragraph). -/
646	theorem ddSound_rename (π α : Ren) (k : K) : DDSound (k.rename π α) ↔ DDSound k := by
647	  constructor
648	  · intro h r r' hd l hl hl'
649	    have hd' : (k.rename π α).DeclaredDisjoint (r.map π.f) (r'.map π.f) := by
650	      simp only [K.rename, Ren.map_gf]; exact hd
651	    exact h _ _ hd' (π.f l) ((π.mem_map_f _ _).2 hl) ((π.mem_map_f _ _).2 hl')
652	  · intro h r r' hd l hl hl'
653	    exact h _ _ hd (π.g l) (List.mem_map_of_mem hl) (List.mem_map_of_mem hl')
654	
655	/-- Guarded steps with corresponding preconditions and related effects correspond (§58; §49, last
656	paragraph). -/
657	theorem guarded_corr {Pre Pre' : Prop} {e e' : S3} (hp : Pre' ↔ Pre)
658	    (he : Pre → SRel π α e e') : StepCorr π α (Guarded Pre e) (Guarded Pre' e') := by
659	  constructor
660	  · intro o ho
661	    cases ho with
662	    | ok hpre => exact ⟨.ok e', .ok (hp.2 hpre), he hpre⟩
663	    | reject hpre => exact ⟨.reject, .reject (fun h' => hpre (hp.1 h')), trivial⟩
664	  · intro o' ho'
665	    cases ho' with
666	    | ok hpre => exact ⟨.ok e, .ok (hp.1 hpre), he (hp.1 hpre)⟩
667	    | reject hpre => exact ⟨.reject, .reject (fun h => hpre (hp.2 h)), trivial⟩
668	
669	end
670	
671	/-- Renaming the arguments by the inverse, then by the renaming, gives the operation back (§60–§75;
672	§49, last paragraph). -/
673	theorem KernelOp.ren_symm_ren (π α : Ren) (op : KernelOp) :
674	    (op.ren π.symm α.symm).ren π α = op := by
675	  cases op <;>
676	    simp [KernelOp.ren, List.map_map, Function.comp_def, π.fg, α.fg]
677	
678	/-- Renaming the arguments, then by the inverse, gives the operation back (§60–§75; §49, last
679	paragraph). -/
680	theorem KernelOp.symm_ren_ren (π α : Ren) (op : KernelOp) :
681	    (op.ren π α).ren π.symm α.symm = op :=
682	  KernelOp.ren_symm_ren π.symm α.symm op
683	
684	end Rename

3	/-!
4	# Renaming of identities: derived notions of a state
5	
6	Equivariance of the state-level notions of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` read by
7	the operations O1–O16 and by the invariants, under related states (§38; §49, last paragraph): the
8	current frame (§39), origin chains and effective anchors (§42, §44), activity (§42), usability,
9	frames of places and live holders (§40, §49.8), effective modes (§43), exercise and the
10	grounding of a right (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3), dependencies (§44), anchor order (§44, §54),
11	dynamic pinning (§74) and leaves of usable places (§66.1).
12	
13	Iff lemmas are proved in one direction and closed by symmetry (`SRel.symm`).
14	-/
15	
16	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename

18	variable {π α : Ren} {s s' : S3}

21	
22	/-- The current frame is kept (§39; §49, last paragraph). -/
23	theorem SRel.top (h : SRel π α s s') : s'.top = s.top := by
24	  unfold S3.top; rw [h.F]

28	  simp only [S3.org]
29	  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
30	  | none => rw [(h.A_none j).1 hy]; rfl
31	  | some y =>
32	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
33	    rw [hy', Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some, hr.origin]

52	  constructor
53	  · rintro ⟨y', hy', ha⟩
54	    obtain ⟨y, hy, hr⟩ := h.A_some' hy'
55	    exact ⟨y, hy, by rw [← hr.active]; exact ha⟩
56	  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ha⟩
57	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy

77	theorem SRel.usable_of (h : SRel π α s s') {q : Nat} (hq : s.Usable q) : s'.Usable (π.f q) := by
78	  induction hq with
79	  | frame hpl hd ho hf =>
80	    rename_i f _
81	    exact .frame (f := f) (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by rw [h.dead]; exact hd)
82	      (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren]) (by rw [h.F]; exact hf)
83	  | place hpl hd ho _ ih =>
84	    exact .place (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by rw [h.dead]; exact hd)

95	  | frame f => show f ∈ s'.F ↔ f ∈ s.F; rw [h.F]
96	  | place p => exact h.usable p

98	/-- `FrameOf` is preserved forward (§40, `placeFrame`; §49, last paragraph). -/
99	theorem SRel.frameOf_of (h : SRel π α s s') {q f : Nat} (hq : FrameOf s q f) :
100	    FrameOf s' (π.f q) f := by
101	  induction hq with
102	  | frame hpl ho =>
103	    exact .frame (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren])
104	  | place hpl ho _ ih =>

108	theorem SRel.frameOf (h : SRel π α s s') (q f : Nat) : FrameOf s' (π.f q) f ↔ FrameOf s q f :=
109	  ⟨fun hq => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using h.symm.frameOf_of hq, h.frameOf_of⟩

123	/-- Modes of covering active descendants are invariant as a set (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
124	theorem SRel.mem_descModes (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (a p : Nat)
125	    (m : Mode) : m ∈ descModes s' (α.f a) (π.f p) ↔ m ∈ descModes s a p := by

127	  constructor
128	  · rintro ⟨j, y', hy', h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
129	    rw [← α.fg j] at hy' h3
130	    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyy⟩ := h.A_some' hy'
131	    refine ⟨α.g j, y, hy, hyy.active ▸ h1, (hyy.mem_footprint p).1 h2,
132	      (h.mem_ancs hd hd' _ _).1 h3, hyy.mode ▸ h4⟩
133	  · rintro ⟨j, y, hy, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
134	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hyy⟩ := h.A_some hy
135	    exact ⟨α.f j, y', hy', hyy.active ▸ h1, (hyy.mem_footprint p).2 h2,
136	      (h.mem_ancs hd hd' _ _).2 h3, hyy.mode.symm ▸ h4⟩

140	    effOf m ds = effOf m ds' := by
141	  have h0 : ds = [] ↔ ds' = [] := by simp only [List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem, h]
142	  simp only [effOf, h0, h Mode.modify]

148	  | none => simp only [Access.effective, hy, (h.A_none a).1 hy]
149	  | some y =>
150	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
151	    simp only [Access.effective, hy, hy', hr.active, hr.mem_footprint, hr.mode,

159	  | none => rw [(h.A_none a).1 hy]; exact .nil
160	  | some y =>

171	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s'.P (π.f q), Allows (Access.effective s' (α.f a) l) m) ↔
172	      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (Access.effective s a l) m :=
173	  π.forall_mem_iff (fun l => h.mem_footprint hd hd' l q)
174	    (fun l => by rw [h.effective hd hd'])

177	
178	/-- `ExercisableAt` is preserved forward (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
179	theorem SRel.exercisableAt_of (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') {a : Nat}
180	    {m : Mode} (he : s.ExercisableAt a m) : s'.ExercisableAt (α.f a) m := by
181	  induction he with
182	  | base hy ha hm hf =>
183	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
184	    exact .base hy' (by rw [hr.active]; exact ha) (by rw [hr.mode]; exact hm)
185	      (by rw [hr.holder, hf, h.top]; rfl)
186	  | held hy ha hm hp _ hc ih =>
187	    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
188	    exact .held hy' (by rw [hr.active]; exact ha) (by rw [hr.mode]; exact hm)
189	      (by rw [hr.holder, hp]; rfl) ih ((h.forall_footprint_allows hd hd' _ _ _).2 hc)

191	/-- `ExercisableAt` is invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
192	theorem SRel.exercisableAt (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (a : Nat)
193	    (m : Mode) : s'.ExercisableAt (α.f a) m ↔ s.ExercisableAt a m :=
194	  ⟨fun he => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, α.gf] using h.symm.exercisableAt_of hd' hd he,
195	   h.exercisableAt_of hd hd'⟩

197	/-- `HasRight` is invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
198	theorem SRel.hasRight (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (m : Mode) (q : Nat) :

667	/-! ## Exercisable authorities (§43) -/
668	
669	/-- `ExercisableAt(s, a, m)` (§43): `a` is active, its own mode permits `m`, and it is held by
670	the current frame, or by a place `p` such that an authority itself exercisable at `m` has an
671	effective mode permitting `m` on every leaf of `p`. Inductive along the holder chain (§43), so no
672	holder cycle justifies a right. -/
673	inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
674	  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
675	      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
676	  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
677	      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
678	      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
679	
680	/-- One step of `ExercisableAt · m` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §43). -/
681	def exR (s : S3) (m : Mode) (E : Nat → Bool) (a : Nat) : Bool :=
682	  match s.A[a]? with
683	  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
684	    | .frame f => decide (f = s.top)
685	    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
686	        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) && E b
687	  | none => false
688	
689	/-- `any` depends only on the values of the predicate on the list (decision procedure for
690	§43). -/
691	theorem any_congr' {α : Type} {f g : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ b ∈ l, f b = g b) →
692	    l.any f = l.any g
693	  | [], _ => rfl
694	  | a :: l, h => by
695	    simp only [List.any_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..),
696	      any_congr' fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb)]
697	
698	/-- `exR` is a bounded monotone rule (decision procedure for §43). -/
699	theorem exR_rule (s : S3) (m : Mode) : KRule s.A.length (exR s m) where
700	  mono p q hpq a h := by
701	    unfold exR at h ⊢; split at h
702	    · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h ⊢
703	      refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩; split at h
704	      · simpa using h.2
705	      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at h ⊢
706	        obtain ⟨b, hb, hc, he⟩ := h.2
707	        exact ⟨b, hb, hc, hpq b he⟩
708	    · exact h
709	  bound p a h := by
710	    unfold exR at h; split at h
711	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
712	    · cases h
713	  loc p q hpq a := by
714	    unfold exR; split
715	    · congr 1; split
716	      · rfl
717	      · exact any_congr' fun b hb => by rw [hpq b (List.mem_range.1 hb)]
718	    · rfl
719	
720	/-- Soundness of the iteration for `ExercisableAt` (decision procedure for §43). -/
721	theorem exercisableAt_of_kiter (s : S3) (m : Mode) :
722	    ∀ k a, kiter (exR s m) k a = true → s.ExercisableAt a m
723	  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
724	  | k + 1, a, h => by
725	    simp only [kiter, exR] at h
726	    split at h
727	    · rename_i y hy
728	      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
729	      obtain ⟨⟨ha, hm⟩, h⟩ := h
730	      split at h
731	      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hy ha hm (by simp at h; rw [hf, h])
732	      · rename_i p hp
733	        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
734	        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
735	        exact .held hy ha hm hp (exercisableAt_of_kiter s m k b hb) hc
736	    · cases h

738	/-- The frame-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
739	theorem exR_base {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a : Nat} {y : Authority}
740	    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode)
741	    (hf : y.holder = .frame s.top) : exR s m E a = true := by
742	  unfold exR; rw [hy]; simp [ha, hm, hf]
743	
744	/-- The place-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
745	theorem exR_held {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a p b : Nat} {y : Authority}
746	    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode) (hp : y.holder = .place p)
747	    (hb : b < s.A.length) (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m)
748	    (hE : E b = true) : exR s m E a = true := by
749	  simp only [exR, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
750	    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
751	  exact ⟨hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩
752	
753	/-- `ExercisableAt` is computed by `|A| + 1` steps of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
754	theorem exercisableAt_iff {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
755	    s.ExercisableAt a m ↔ kiter (exR s m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
756	  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exercisableAt_of_kiter s m _ a⟩
757	  induction h with
758	  | base hy ha hm hf => exact exR_base hy ha hm hf
759	  | held hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
760	    rw [← kiter_fix (exR_rule s _)]
761	    have hb' := kiter_bound (exR_rule s _) _ _ ih
762	    exact exR_held hy ha hm hp hb' hc ih
763	
764	/-- Decidability of `ExercisableAt` (§43). -/
765	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (s.ExercisableAt a m) :=
766	  decidable_of_iff _ exercisableAt_iff.symm

768	/-- `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43): the current frame has an authority exercisable at `m` whose
769	effective mode permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
770	def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
771	  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
772	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m

774	/-- Decidability of `HasRight` (§43). -/
775	instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by

778	/-- Authority `g` grounds the right `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3: "the
779	exercisable authority on which that right rests"): it is exercisable at `m` and its effective mode
780	permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
781	def Grounds (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Prop :=
782	  g ∈ List.range s.A.length ∧ s.ExercisableAt g m ∧
783	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s g l) m

814	ancestor of `fd` (§44). -/

816	  OptP (s.A[s.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.hframe z.holder)
817	    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) False) False) False

823	/-- `AnchorOrder` (§44, §54): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable place `q`, the frame of the
824	effective anchor of `x` is the frame of `q` or an ancestor. -/
825	def AnchorOrder (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
826	
827	/-- `AnchorOrder` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for §44). -/
828	theorem anchorOrder_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrder s ↔
829	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q) :=
830	  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩
831	
832	/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrder` (§44). -/
833	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrder s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrder_iff.symm
834	
835	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54): the rule of `AnchorOrder` for every active authority held by a
836	usable place `q`. -/
837	def AnchorOrderHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
838	  ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
839	    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
840	
841	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure for
842	§44). -/
843	theorem anchorOrderHeld_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrderHeld s ↔
844	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
845	      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
846	        EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) True := by
847	  constructor
848	  · intro h q _ hq x _
849	    unfold OptP; split
850	    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
851	    · trivial
852	  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
853	    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
854	    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh
855	
856	/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44). -/
857	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeld s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeld_iff.symm

861	/-- `Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail` (§58). `fail` leaves the state unchanged and
862	carries none. -/
863	inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
864	  | ok (s : σ)
865	  | reject
866	  | fail

868	/-- A kernel transition other than `alloc` (§58): `ok` with the effect when the preconditions
869	hold, `reject` otherwise; never `fail`. -/
870	inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
871	  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
872	  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject

747	    (hb : b < s.A.length) (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m)
748	    (hE : E b = true) : exR s m E a = true := by
749	  simp only [exR, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
750	    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
751	  exact ⟨hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩
752	
753	/-- `ExercisableAt` is computed by `|A| + 1` steps of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
754	theorem exercisableAt_iff {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
755	    s.ExercisableAt a m ↔ kiter (exR s m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
756	  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exercisableAt_of_kiter s m _ a⟩
757	  induction h with
758	  | base hy ha hm hf => exact exR_base hy ha hm hf
759	  | held hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
760	    rw [← kiter_fix (exR_rule s _)]
761	    have hb' := kiter_bound (exR_rule s _) _ _ ih
762	    exact exR_held hy ha hm hp hb' hc ih
763	
764	/-- Decidability of `ExercisableAt` (§43). -/
765	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (s.ExercisableAt a m) :=
766	  decidable_of_iff _ exercisableAt_iff.symm
767	
768	/-- `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43): the current frame has an authority exercisable at `m` whose
769	effective mode permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
770	def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
771	  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
772	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m
773	
774	/-- Decidability of `HasRight` (§43). -/
775	instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by
776	  unfold HasRight; infer_instance
777	
778	/-- Authority `g` grounds the right `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3: "the
779	exercisable authority on which that right rests"): it is exercisable at `m` and its effective mode
780	permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
781	def Grounds (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Prop :=
782	  g ∈ List.range s.A.length ∧ s.ExercisableAt g m ∧
783	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s g l) m
784	
785	/-- Decidability of `Grounds` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
786	instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Decidable (Grounds s m q g) := by
787	  unfold Grounds; infer_instance
788	
789	/-- Authority `j` is the grounding authority `g` or belongs to its origin chain (§63.4, §69.2,
790	§70.3: "the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain"). -/
791	def RightChain (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Prop := j = g ∨ j ∈ s.ancs g
792	
793	/-- Decidability of `RightChain` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
794	instance (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (RightChain s g j) := by
795	  unfold RightChain; infer_instance
796	
797	/-! ## Dependencies and anchors (§44) -/
798	
799	/-- Anchors of the value at `q`, inherited from its parts (§44: dependencies of contained values
800	are accounted for transitively). -/
801	def depsOf (s : S3) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
802	  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r => decide (partOf s.P r q)).flatMap s.D
803	
804	/-- The anchors of every place containing leaf `p` are valid, that is, active (§44; §66.3,
805	§67.3, §68.3). -/
806	def DepsValid (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
807	  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, partOf s.P p q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x
808	
809	/-- Decidability of `DepsValid` (§44). -/
810	instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (DepsValid s p) :=
811	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _ ∈ _, _))
812	
813	/-- The frame of the effective anchor of `x` (the frame of its holder) exists and is `fd` or an
814	ancestor of `fd` (§44). -/
815	def EffAnchorOK (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
816	  OptP (s.A[s.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.hframe z.holder)
817	    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) False) False) False
818	
819	/-- Decidability of `EffAnchorOK` (§44). -/
820	instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOK s x fd) := by
821	  unfold EffAnchorOK; infer_instance
822	
823	/-- `AnchorOrder` (§44, §54): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable place `q`, the frame of the
824	effective anchor of `x` is the frame of `q` or an ancestor. -/
825	def AnchorOrder (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
826	
827	/-- `AnchorOrder` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for §44). -/
828	theorem anchorOrder_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrder s ↔
829	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q) :=
830	  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩
831	
832	/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrder` (§44). -/
833	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrder s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrder_iff.symm
834	
835	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54): the rule of `AnchorOrder` for every active authority held by a
836	usable place `q`. -/
837	def AnchorOrderHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
838	  ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
839	    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
840	
841	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure for
842	§44). -/
843	theorem anchorOrderHeld_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrderHeld s ↔
844	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
845	      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
846	        EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) True := by
847	  constructor
848	  · intro h q _ hq x _
849	    unfold OptP; split
850	    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
851	    · trivial
852	  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
853	    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
854	    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh
855	
856	/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44). -/
857	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeld s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeld_iff.symm
858	
859	/-! ## Outcomes (§58) -/
860	
861	/-- `Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail` (§58). `fail` leaves the state unchanged and
862	carries none. -/
863	inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
864	  | ok (s : σ)
865	  | reject
866	  | fail
867	
868	/-- A kernel transition other than `alloc` (§58): `ok` with the effect when the preconditions
869	hold, `reject` otherwise; never `fail`. -/
870	inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
871	  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
872	  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject
873	
874	end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

content.content:
## 49. WF3 — Well-Formedness of Frames, Places, and Authorities

`WF3(s)` is a **predicate on state `s`**. It jointly requires:

1. a nonempty, duplicate-free frame stack, every frame having a valid identity and, except for the base frame, a valid parent; frame-parent relations are well-founded;
2. a place structure whose composition links are valid and **acyclic**; every structural part shares its parent's owner and death marker;
3. valid owners of type frame or place, and **well-founded** ownership chains reaching a live frame for every usable place;
4. footprints consisting exclusively of leaves of existing places;
5. authorities with valid identities and modes, whose existing origins form **acyclic** chains ending at a root authority;
6. `RootChain`: every origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at the root of the **same structural root place** as that leaf;
7. `RootHeld`: every usable root place has its active root `Modify` authority, with no origin, held exactly by its owner;
8. holder validity: every active authority is held by a frame present in the stack or by a usable place.

Numerical ordering of identifiers, parent precedence over child in a list, and bounds on generated identifiers may be used **to represent or prove** this well-formedness in a formalization; they are not normative restrictions on place or authority identities. Preservation of `WF3` by a transition is a **required property of transitions**, not an additional clause of the state predicate. `WF3` does not impose any particular physical object layout: that belongs to refinement into the elementary memory machine.

## 50. I1 — Structural Exclusivity

For two active authorities **unrelated by derivation** covering the same leaf, their own modes must both be `Observe`. This rule also applies to leaves identified as `SharedMutable`; their particular mutation is governed by the `writeShared` contract and creates no exception to I1.

Exclusivity of **effective** modes (`effective_exclusive`) is a consequence of I1 and the definition of `effective`, not the definition of I1. On a leaf, two incompatible authorities cannot simultaneously possess incompatible effective rights. The only permitted independent ordinary coexistence is `Observe` / `Observe`.

## 51. I2 — Conservation of Rights

A derived authority covers only a subfootprint of what its origin chain permits and does not elevate its mode. Derivation and splitting restrictions do not allow duplication of an exclusive right over a leaf. Every active authority is linked to a valid origin according to state and reanchoring rules: an origin is **valid** if and only if it is active, so the origin of an active derived authority is active. Partial suspension follows from `effective`.

## 52. I3 — Validity of Anchors and Dependencies

Every explicit anchor of a still-usable place is valid. An operation cannot invalidate an anchor retained by a place that remains usable. Transitive propagation of dependencies from contained values does not change this obligation. Dependencies are not permissions and are insufficient to justify an access.

## 53. I4 — Consumption and Movement

A `Moved` leaf cannot be read as if it still contained its previous value. Moving a value does not preserve two copies of an exclusive authority. Initialization state and authority-exercise state are separate checks.

## 54. Anchor Ordering and Absence of Orphan Rights

`AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` are defined in Section 44. `NoDangling` prohibits an **active** authority from covering a leaf belonging to an unusable place; the invariant does not say that a leaf is initialized. `NoOrphan` requires every active authority held by a place to be connected to a frame in the stack through a **finite, non-repeating chain** of authorities: the first link is held by a live frame, and each active link **structurally covers the entirety** of the place holding the next link. The link need not have an effective mode over that place. `NoOrphan` guarantees neither the exercisability of all stored authorities nor freedom from blocking.

## 55. ArenaInv — Invariant of the Arena Abstraction

`ArenaInv` is an invariant of the **library contract**, not an additional predicate of kernel state. For every live arena:

- `storage` designates an existing, usable place; the footprint of `internal` is exactly the footprint of `storage`;
- `internal` is active, with own mode `Modify`, held by the arena value;
- available leaves and issued regions belong to the administered storage;
- two still-active issuances have disjoint regions; no leaf of a still-issued region simultaneously belongs to `available`;
- every still-issued block authority is a derivative of `internal` complying with exclusivity and validity rules;
- anchor and ownership restrictions are respected.

## 60. O1 — Derivation of an Authority

**Preconditions**

1. `source` is an active derived or root authority, and `ExercisableAt(s,source,mode)` holds; its origin chain and anchors are valid: every authority of its origin chain, its effective anchor included, is active.
2. The leaves of `region` exist and belong to the footprint of `source`; `mode` does not exceed the available effective right on these leaves.
3. The addition preserves exclusivity I1: no unrelated active authority becomes incompatible with the derived right, and already-active descendants are respected.
4. The new holding frame is the live current frame. The admissible state's footprint and anchoring restrictions remain true.

**`ok` effect:** A new active authority with fresh identity, origin `source`, requested mode and footprint, and held by the current frame is added. The source remains active; its effective modes are recomputed per leaf. No storage or place anchor is created. Multiple compatible observations remain permitted. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

## 61. O2 — Splitting Authorities

**Preconditions**

1. `source` is active and exercisable by the current frame with sufficient modification rights over the relevant leaves.
2. Each region lies within the available, effectively modifiable footprint of the source.
3. Regions are pairwise disjoint under structural composition or contract `K.DeclaredDisjoint`, subject to obligation `DDSound(K)`; no exclusive right already distributed is overlapped.
4. Creation of the derivatives respects origins, conservation I1/I2, and validity obligations.

**`ok` effect:** An active derived `Modify` authority held by the current frame is created for each region. `source` remains active; its effective modification capability disappears only over distributed leaves and remains on undistributed leaves. Authorities are split logically: `split` performs no physical allocation. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

An unjustified declaration of disjointness may invalidate the proof: without `DDSound`, an accepted `split` may violate I1. Constructing zero-sized subregions is not identified with an allocation of the elementary memory machine; the case of an empty shape in `alloc` is distinct.

## 62. O3 — End of a Derived Borrow

**Preconditions**

1. `authority` is active **and derived**: an authority with no origin is rejected.
2. It is held by the current frame, or by a place `p` on which the current frame has exercisable `Modify`.
3. No active descendant of the authority prevents its release; no other still-usable value may lose a required anchor.
4. If the authority is stored in its holding place, that place is exempted from the check “this authority still appears among the anchors” **only because the effect removes that anchor at the same time**. An anchor with the same identity attached by `depend` to another usable place continues to block the step.
5. Applicable abstraction contracts remain satisfied.

**`ok` effect:** The authority becomes inactive and can no longer be exercised. It is removed from its holding place's anchors when stored there. Effective modes of its origins are recomputed, allowing unblocked rights to return. There is no implicit deallocation. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

# IX. Transfer, Dependencies, and Storage of Rights

These transitions govern value consumption and the controlled movement of their dependencies. A valid transition can neither create an additional permission nor discard a surviving anchor.

## 63. O4 — Consuming Value Transfer
## 64. O5 — Explicit Attachment of an Anchor

**Preconditions**

1. `result` is a usable place over which the current frame has exercisable `Modify`.
2. `anchor` designates an active, valid authority representing a real dependency of the relevant rights or storage; a declared dependency cannot extend an origin's lifetime.
3. Existing anchors are preserved and the addition respects `AnchorOrder`: the effective anchor's frame is the frame of `result` or an ancestor thereof.
4. Every dependency carried by a contained value remains represented in the transitive obligations of its container.

**`ok` effect:** `anchor` is added to `D(result)`; the container's transitive dependencies account for it. No additional access right is created. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

A safe interface must declare dependencies covering those actually required by its implementation; the annotation itself is not presumed true. An unsafe abstraction bears the obligations of its contract.

## 65. O8 — Controlled Storage of an Authority

**Preconditions**

1. `authority` is active, **derived**, and held by the current frame; a root authority can never be stored by `store`.
2. `target` is a usable **leaf** under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame. It holds no other **active** authority. Its data already being `Init` does not by itself prohibit the operation.
3. The stored authority covers neither a leaf of `target` nor the leaves of storage transitively owned by it.
4. The effective anchor of `authority` respects `AnchorOrder` relative to the frame of `target`; other dependencies are preserved.
5. **In the resulting state**, `target` remains under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame (`store_keeps_target_reachable`), and `AnchorOrderHeld` remains true. This is a genuine additional precondition, not an automatic consequence of the preceding ones.

**`ok` effect:** The holder of `authority` becomes `target`; the authority is added to `D(target)`; **only** leaf `target` becomes `Init`. Other fields of a structure, even adjacent ones, do not change their initialization state. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

Overwriting an active authority already held by the leaf is prohibited; its explicit release may make the target reusable. The resulting-state clause does not by itself prohibit all cycles possible after other operations: general freedom from blocking (`NoLock`) is not adopted here.

# X. Reading, Writing, and Initialization

A leaf's initialization state and the effective right to access it are two distinct conditions.

## 66. O9 — Safe Reading of Regions

**Preconditions**

1. Every leaf being read belongs to a usable place and is `Init`.
2. `access` is an authority exercisable in `Observe` mode over the region; its **effective** mode actually permits observation of each leaf being read.
3. Required anchors are valid, and the type and storage contract permits this read.

**`ok` effect:** The logical read succeeds, without modifying `F`, `P`, `I`, `A`, `D`, or arena entries. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

`Moved` and `Uninit` cannot be read. This definition does not replace concrete representation and pointer checks of the elementary memory machine.

## 67. O10 — Ordinary Write

**Preconditions**

1. Targeted leaves belong to usable places, and `access` is exercisable in `Modify` mode with **effective** `Modify` right over each leaf.
2. No incompatible ordinary authority holds an incompatible effective mode over the written leaves (I1).
3. Anchors and constraints of the relevant types, storage, and abstractions remain valid.

**`ok` effect:** The logical write sets the actually written leaves to `Init` and does not modify authorities or their anchors. An unwritten leaf does not become `Init` by this effect. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

## 68. O11 — Write Under Shared Mutation

**Preconditions**

1. Every leaf in the region is usable and declared `K.SharedMutable`.
2. `access` is exercisable in a mode **at least** `Observe` and has a present effective mode on every leaf, either `Observe` or `Modify`; exercising an authority without an effective mode is insufficient.
3. Dependencies are valid and the particular shared-mutation discipline guaranteed by `K.SharedMutable` applies.

**`ok` effect:** Actually written leaves become `Init`; authorities and their structural exclusivity I1 do not change. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

`writeShared` may update metadata under an `Observe` authority when the contract permits. Stability of observed contents is not automatically guaranteed, and this kernel **does not prove** the absence of data races: that requires the concurrency model's guarantees.

# XI. End of Use, Deallocation, and Allocation
## 74. O15 — Dynamic Pinning

**Preconditions:** `place` is usable, the current frame has exercisable `Modify` over the relevant leaves, and the operation respects applicable pinning obligations.

**`ok` effect:** A dynamic pinning obligation of fresh identity is installed on the relevant leaves. A leaf is dynamically pinned while at least one active pinning obligation covers it. While an obligation is active, `transfer`, `endUse`, `free`, and `exitFrame` are rejected if they act on leaves it pins; removal of this obligation requires `unpin` under `K.ExternalDone`. Pinning does not make contents immutable. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

## 75. O16 — Removal of Dynamic Pinning

**Preconditions:** `unpin` designates one active dynamic pinning obligation, installed by `pin` on `place`; `place` is usable, the current frame has exercisable `Modify`, and contract `K.ExternalDone`, applied to that obligation, attests that all relevant external use has ended.

**`ok` effect:** The designated dynamic pinning obligation ends, and only that one: a leaf it covered stays pinned while another active obligation covers it. The step does not itself modify values, their initialization, or their access authorities. Static obligations are not removed by this operation. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

**Associated static rule (`StaticPinnedBottom`):** Statics designated by `K.Pinned` must be places **directly** owned by the **base frame**, not merely transitively owned by a static value. This restriction ensures that they do not die when an intermediate frame exits.

# XIV. Arenas and Collective Invalidation — Reference Abstraction

889	
890	/-- Static preconditions of `alloc provider owner shape` (§71, items 1–3). -/
891	structure AllocStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
892	  /-- §71.1: the shape is nonempty. -/
893	  nonempty : ls ≠ []
894	  /-- §71.1: the shape is represented like the locals of `enterFrame` (each parent is an earlier
895	  element). -/
896	  shapeOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
897	  /-- §71.1 with the `ok` outcome of §71 ("a new storage root"): exactly one element has no
898	  parent. -/
899	  oneRoot : (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1
900	  /-- §71.2: the provider is a usable place. -/
901	  providerUsable : s.Usable provider
902	  /-- §71.2: all leaves of the provider are `Init`. -/
903	  providerInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init
904	  /-- §71.2: metadata updates are permitted through exercisable `Modify` on the provider or a
905	  valid `writeShared` (§68) over its leaves. -/
906	  providerRight : HasRight s .modify provider ∨
907	    ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)
908	  /-- §71.3: exercisable `Modify` over `owner`. -/
909	  ownerRight : HasRight s .modify owner
910	  /-- §71.3 (liveness restrictions): `owner` is usable. -/
911	  ownerUsable : s.Usable owner
912	
913	/-- Decidability of the static preconditions of `alloc` (§71). -/
914	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
915	    (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (AllocStatic k s provider owner ls) :=
916	  decidable_of_iff (ls ≠ [] ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1 ∧
917	    s.Usable provider ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init) ∧
918	    (HasRight s .modify provider ∨
919	      ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)) ∧
920	    HasRight s .modify owner ∧ s.Usable owner)
921	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
922	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩
923	
924	/-- Places after `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): the elements of the shape appended, owned by
925	`owner`. -/
926	def allocP (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place :=
927	  shapeP s.P (.place owner) ls.toShape
928	
929	/-- Effect of `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): a new storage root of fresh identities owned by
930	`owner`, its leaves `Uninit`, no anchor, alive, with a root `Modify` authority with no origin held
931	by `owner`; pinning obligations are unchanged. -/
932	def allocEff (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
933	  { s with
934	    P := allocP s owner ls
935	    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
936	    A := s.A ++ (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
937	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s owner ls) (s.P.length + i),
938	        shapeOwner ls.toShape (.place owner) i, true⟩
939	    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
940	    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q }
941	
942	/-- `alloc provider owner shape` as a relation (§71 outcomes, §58): `reject` when a static
943	precondition fails; `fail`, state unchanged, when `K.Satisfiable` is false; `ok` otherwise. -/
944	inductive AllocStep (k : K) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) :
945	    Outcome3 S3 → Prop where
946	  | ok : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
947	      AllocStep k provider owner ls s (.ok (allocEff s owner ls))
948	  | fail : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → ¬ k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
949	      AllocStep k provider owner ls s .fail
